press_references.value: First Avenue consortium secures $533mln Makkah development project

partnership_announcements.description: First Avenue for Real Estate Development, Dar Al Majed Real Estate (Al Majdiah), and Rekaz Real Estate formed a consortium that secured a major development contract from the Royal Commission for Makkah City and Holy Sites to deliver the SAR2 billion East Hindawiyah District mixed-use project in Makkah, financed via a Jadwa Investment-managed fund.

press_references.value: First Avenue signs deal with Asas Makeen for Saudi residential project

partnership_announcements.description: First Avenue for Real Estate Development signed an addendum to its existing contract with Asas Makeen Real Estate to execute a SAR86 million townhouse residential compound project in Al Hada District, Saudi Arabia, on a turnkey basis.

press_references.value: First Avenue inks contract for key Saudi mixed-use project

partnership_announcements.description: First Avenue for Real Estate Development Company has contracted Jadwa Al Shorfa Real Estate Fund to design, supervise construction, and market the Capital Avenue - Al Rayyan mixed-use project in Riyadh, aligning with First Avenue's expansion strategy.

press_references.value: Saudi Wood Expo returns to Riyadh from 1-3 September unlocking opportunities across the Kingdom’s $1 billion wood and woodworking sector

partnership_announcements.description: First Avenue for Real Estate Development signed a contract with Al Shati Real Estate Fund to develop a 15,619 sqm mixed-use project in Jeddah’s Al Shati District.

press_references.value: First Avenue, Asas Makeen ink deal to develop Jadah Al-Huda project in Riyadh

partnership_announcements.description: First Avenue for Real Estate Development and Asas Makeen Real Estate Development and Investment signed a contract to jointly develop the Jadah Al-Huda residential project in Riyadh, marking a new strategic partnership in the real estate sector.
